detailZh: 安东内利 被冠以2026年F1世界冠军，作为冠军，维斯塔潘在墨西哥城大奖赛中险胜 汉密尔顿
安东内利 以20岁68天的年龄赢得了2026年F1车手总冠军，打破 Sebastian Vettel 保持的最年轻世界冠军记录；维斯塔潘 在充满戏剧性的墨西哥城大奖赛中战胜 汉密尔顿
2026年墨西哥城大奖赛的精彩瞬间，安东内利成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军
安东内利 成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军，维斯塔潘在墨西哥城大奖赛中抵挡住了 汉密尔顿 的挑战
安东内利在距离赛季结束还有四轮的情况下，以第三名的成绩锁定了F1车手总冠军，成为自1953年阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里以来首位意大利世界冠军。
这位20岁的年轻人避开了本赛季最激动人心的比赛中的一切混乱，在终点线后情绪激动。

“我们做到了，我们做到了。没有梅赛德斯，没有我的家人，我就不会在这里，所以我对这个时刻非常感激，这将永远铭记于心，”安东内利说。 “我无话可说。我正在努力处理刚刚发生的事情。”
基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯 - 20年68天（2026年）
塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔，红牛 - 23年134天（2010年）
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，麦克拉伦 - 23年300天（2008年）
费尔南多·阿隆索，雷诺车队 - 24岁58天（2005年）
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队 - 24岁73天（2021年）
与此同时，维斯塔潘利用汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔在首圈的大规模碰撞中，赢得了他连续四场比赛中的第三场胜利。
杆位车手汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔在1号和2号弯道并排行驶，之后勒克莱尔再次在4号弯道外侧发起攻击。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在比赛重启阶段超越了自己的法拉利车队队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔，但在争夺领先时与马克斯·维斯塔潘相撞
两位车手都离开了赛道，但勒克莱尔穿过草地取得了领先，让维斯塔潘得以利用这个机会超越汉密尔顿
勒克莱尔被处以五秒的罚时，但愤怒的汉密尔顿在无线电中说“裁判们基本上是在处理查尔斯的这场胜利”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在比赛首圈超越了自己的法拉利车队队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔时离开了赛道，但只因为违规被处以五秒的罚时
维斯塔潘在唯一的一轮进站停泊前保持在勒克莱尔五秒之内，但似乎与法拉利相比车辆性能略逊一筹，并且正在使用老化的软胎。
然而，当凯迪拉克的瓦尔特里·博塔斯在悬挂系统故障后发生巨大碰撞撞向护栏时，比赛被停止，此时还剩下26圈未完成，比赛以静止起步的方式重新开始。
勒克莱尔从第二位出发表现不佳，汉密尔顿在第一个弯道攻击维斯塔潘，两人发生接触，最终红牛车手占据上风。
即使小红牛（小红牛）的阿维德·林德布拉德在与其他麦克拉伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里纠缠后发生碰撞，比赛被迫使用安全车，但维斯塔潘仍然做得足够好，以安东内利紧随其后，保持在汉密尔顿的身后。
瓦尔特里·博塔斯在墨西哥城的周日比赛中，他的凯迪拉克赛车悬挂系统故障，重重地撞上了护栏
勒克莱尔凭借磨损严重的胎面轮胎拼到了第四名，而麦克拉伦的兰多·诺里斯获得了第五名，梅赛德斯-奔驰的乔治·罗素排名第六
皮亚斯蒂排名第七，领先于阿尔皮纳的弗朗科·科拉平托、小红牛的利亚姆·劳森和另一位阿尔皮纳车手皮埃尔·加斯利

detailEn: Kimi Antonelli crowned 2026 F1 world champion as Max Verstappen wins wild Mexico City Grand Prix from Lewis Hamilton

Kimi Antonelli has won the 2026 F1 Drivers' Championship at 20 years and 68 days old, breaking Sebastian Vettel's record for youngest world champion by three years; Max Verstappen won a wild Mexico City Grand Prix from Lewis Hamilton amid drama between the Ferrari drivers
Highlights from the 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix as Kimi Antonelli became the youngest world champion in F1 history
Kimi Antonelli became the youngest Formula 1 world champion in history as Max Verstappen held off Lewis Hamilton to win a thrilling Mexico City Grand Prix.
Antonelli finished third to secure the F1 Drivers' Championship with four rounds to spare, becoming the first Italian world champion since Alberto Ascari in 1953.
The 20-year-old avoided all the chaos in one of the most action-packed races of the season and was hugely emotional after the chequered flag.

"We did it, we did it. I wouldn't be here without Mercedes, without my family, so I'm very grateful for this moment and it's one that will live forever," said Antonelli. "I'm speechless. I'm trying to process what has just happened."
Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes - 20 years and 68 days (2026)
Sebastian Vettel, Red Bull - 23 years and 134 days (2010)
Lewis Hamilton, McLaren - 23 years and 300 days (2008)
Fernando Alonso,, Renault - 24 years and 58 days (2005)
Max Verstappen, Red Bull - 24 years and 73 days (2021)
Meanwhile, Verstappen took advantage of a big fight between the Ferraris of Hamilton and Charles Leclerc on the opening lap to claim his third win in four races.
Pole-sitter Hamilton went side by side with Leclerc through the tight Turns 1 and 2 before Leclerc attacked again into Turn 4 around the outside.
Lewis Hamilton overtook Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc before colliding with Max Verstappen as they battled for the lead in the race restart
Both drivers went off the track but Leclerc went across the grass to take the lead, allowing Verstappen to capitalise by overtaking Hamilton.
Leclerc was handed a five-second time penalty but a furious Hamilton said "the stewards are basically handling Charles this win" on the radio.
Lewis Hamilton was left furious after Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc overtook him on the opening lap while leaving the track but was only given a five-second penalty for the infringement
Verstappen stayed within five seconds of Leclerc before the only round of pit stops to take the lead but appeared to have an inferior car compared to the Ferraris, and was on aging soft tyres.
However, the race was stopped when Cadillac's Valtteri Bottas suffered a huge crash into the barriers as his suspension failed, leaving a standing-start restart with 26 laps remaining.
Leclerc got a poor launch from second so Hamilton attacked Verstappen into Turn 1, with the pair making contact as the Red Bull driver came out on top.
Even with a Safety Car for Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad crashing after tangling with McLaren's Oscar Piastri, Verstappen did just enough to keep Hamilton at bay with Antonelli just behind in third.
Valtteri Bottas suffered a suspension failure in his Cadillac as he crashed heavily into the barriers during Sunday's race in Mexico City
Leclerc battled his way to fourth with flat-spotted front tyres, while McLaren's Lando Norris finished fifth and Mercedes' George Russell sixth.
Piastri was seventh ahead of Alpine's Franco Colapinto, Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson and the other Alpine of Pierre Gasly.

items.originalTitle: F1 Mexico GP: Kimi Antonelli clinches world title as Max Verstappen holds off Lewis Hamilton for victory
detailZh: F1墨西哥大奖赛：基米·安东内利夺得世界冠军，马克斯·维斯塔潘力压刘易斯·汉密尔顿夺冠
基米·安东内利在墨西哥城大奖赛中成为一级方程式历史上最年轻的世界冠军，马克斯·维斯塔潘击败刘易斯·汉密尔顿
刘易斯·汉密尔顿、法拉利、马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队、安德烈亚·基米·安东内利、梅赛德斯
基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛中创造了历史，成为一级方程式历史上最年轻的世界冠军，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘击败法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿赢得比赛。
维斯塔潘在71圈比赛中唯一的停站发生在第28圈，他趁机超越早先领先的勒克莱尔，并在对抗勒克莱尔的队友汉密尔顿时成功防守，最终夺得胜利，安东内利在第三名的领奖台上庆祝他首次获得F1冠军。
由于拉塞尔和汉密尔顿都没有赢得比赛，安东内利的比赛成绩无关紧要，但他通过在比赛后半段巧妙地超越勒克莱尔，展现了他成熟稳定的夺冠策略。
在比赛开始时，杆位发车的汉密尔顿在第二个和第四个弯道处被勒克莱尔挑战，试图夺回领先位置。勒克莱尔为了超越队友，甚至切过了草地，而汉密尔顿失去了对第三名维斯塔潘的领先优势，后者利用车队内部的争斗抢走了汉密尔顿的第二名位置。
“我被自己的队友推开了，”汉密尔顿懊悔地说，因为维斯塔潘也在试图让勒克莱尔归还位置。摩纳哥车手只因为离开赛道并获得优势而受到了五秒的处罚，这在维斯塔潘和他的队友看来都显得有些轻微：“他拥有干净的空气，不需要像我们其他人那样管理。”汉密尔顿指出。
在背景中，伊萨克·哈德贾的第二辆小红牛赛车被起步缓慢的乔治·拉塞尔推了出去，拉塞尔从第二位跌至第六位，并被处以10秒的罚时。
正如汉密尔顿所说，勒克莱尔很快将差距扩大到5秒，领先于第二名的维斯塔潘——这位荷兰人是在中胎而不是软胎上起步的唯一领跑者。汉密尔顿在两辆梅赛德斯和两辆麦凯轮赛车之后，落后了另外几秒。奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂从令人失望的第12个发车位起步，凭借强劲的起步上升至第七位，落后领先车队7秒。
勒克莱尔和维斯塔潘在第28圈各自进站一次，进行唯一的一次停站，勒克莱尔换上了中胎，而维斯塔潘则换上了软胎。得益于勒克莱尔额外的5秒保持，维斯塔潘能够在维修区超越法拉利，掌控比赛，尽管轮胎复合材料的韧性更差。
维斯塔潘的赛事工程师吉安皮耶罗·兰比亚斯说：“我们基本上需要你一次墨西哥站的神奇表现，”汉密尔顿在下一圈收集中胎后，将领先的三人降至第四、第五和第六位。
它让安东内利在 拉塞尔 和 诺里斯 的帮助下，在赛道前端享受了一小段清静时光，因为梅赛德斯没有真正的战略选择来争夺胜利——尽管安东内利在争夺冠军的过程中对此并不介意。
安东内利是那一组三人中最后一个在第 44 圈进入维修区的，这超过了 71 圈比赛的一半，这表明红牛车队对软胎的耐久性几乎不用担心。
但就在安东内利进入维修区，放弃追上幸运的安全车时，瓦尔特里·博塔斯的凯迪拉克在 1 号弯处因左前悬挂故障撞墙，不仅引来了安全车，还拉起了红旗。博塔斯被送往医疗中心进行预防性检查，但没有受伤。
经过近 40 分钟的围栏修复等待后，比赛以标准重启的方式继续进行，维斯塔潘领先勒克莱尔、汉密尔顿、安东内利、诺里斯、拉塞尔和皮亚斯特里，他们都在使用一套软胎。在 47 圈的重启中，维斯塔潘被迫防守汉密尔顿，后者起跑时加速巨大，超过了勒克莱尔，升至第二位。
当勒克莱尔在1号弯锁死时，维斯塔潘在墨西哥的第一弯段抵挡住了汉密尔顿的进攻，这是唯一的真正超车机会。但汉密尔顿没有放弃，继续对领先的法拉利车队施加压力。
安东内利不想在福罗索尔领奖台上庆祝他的冠军成功，在第48圈时从勒克莱尔那里强行超车，获得了第三名。勒克莱尔在重启时锁死，导致轮胎出现磨损，他的麻烦继续，随后在第四名的争夺中被诺里斯施压。
当阿维德·林德布拉德在与皮亚斯特里发生碰撞后从第七名冲出赛道，引发了一次安全车出动，比赛又出现了新的转折。
这次重置给了汉密尔顿另一个机会，在比赛在第65圈恢复时，从他的老对手维斯塔潘那里抢走胜利。
尽管汉密尔顿在每一圈都紧追维斯塔潘，但他最终没有选择余地，只能接受第二名，而维斯塔潘则赢得了本赛季的第三个大奖赛胜利，也是四场比赛中的第三个胜利。
含泪的安东内利在第三名冲过终点，享受着他的车手世界冠军，以20岁的年龄打破了塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔的三岁年龄记录。
勒克莱尔在诺里斯、拉塞尔和皮亚斯特里之前保持第四名。弗朗科·科拉平托以第八名的成绩成为其他车手中的最佳，利亚姆·劳森和皮埃尔·加斯利完成了前十名。
除了林德布拉德和博托莱托的退赛，奥利弗·贝尔曼在重启后第4弯被尼科·胡肯伯格撞出赛道，赛车悬挂损坏后消失。
两辆阿斯顿·马丁赛车在经历了又一次锻炼意志的挑战后，由于新本田动力单元的问题，在仅仅跑了七圈后就被迫停车。
detailEn: F1 Mexico GP: Kimi Antonelli clinches world title as Max Verstappen holds off Lewis Hamilton for victory
Kimi Antonelli becomes Formula 1's youngest-ever world champion at the Mexico City Grand Prix, as Max Verstappen defeats Lewis Hamilton
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
Kimi Antonelli has written history by becoming Formula 1's youngest-ever world champion at the Mexico Grand Prix, as Red Bull's Max Verstappen beat Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton to win the race.

Verstappen seized control of the race during the only pitstop of the race on lap 28 of 71, leapfrogging early leader Charles Leclerc, and he fended off Leclerc's team-mate Hamilton to take victory, with Antonelli celebrating his maiden F1 title with a podium spot in third.

With neither Russell nor Hamilton winning the race, Antonelli's race result was irrelevant, but he underlined his mature title winning campaign with a controlled drive as he picked off Leclerc in the second half of the race.

At the start, polesitter Hamilton was challenged by Leclerc for the lead into Turn 2 and again towards Turn 4-5. Leclerc cut the grass to pass his team-mate as Hamilton lost momentum to third-placed Verstappen as well, who took advantage of the intra-team tussle to snatch second away from Hamilton.

"I got pushed off by my own team-mate," Hamilton rued, as Verstappen was also angling for Leclerc to hand back the position. The Monegasque only received a five-second penalty for leaving the track and gaining an advantage, which was deemed rather soft by both Verstappen and his own team-mate: "He's got clean air, he doesn't have to manage like the rest of us," Hamilton pointed out.
In the background, the second Red Bull of Isack Hadjar was punted off by slow-starting George Russell, who had dropped from second to sixth and was handed a 10-second time penalty.

To Hamilton's point, Leclerc soon pulled out a five-second gap to second-placed Verstappen - the Dutchman only frontrunner to start on medium tyres instead of softs. Hamilton trailed by another couple of seconds ahead of the two Mercedes and the two McLaren cars. A strong start from Oscar Piastri saw him move up from a disappointing 12th grid slot to seventh, seven seconds behind the leading train.

Leclerc and Verstappen both pitted on lap 28 for their only pitstop, with Leclerc moving to mediums and Verstappen switching to softs. Helped by Leclerc's additional five-second hold, Verstappen was able to jump the Ferrari in pitlane to take charge of the race, albeit on the more brittle tyre compound.

"We basically need one of your magic Mexico stints," declared Verstappen's race engineer Gianpiero Lambiase, as Hamilton's next-lap response by collecting mediums dropped the leading trio to fourth, fifth and sixth respectively.

It handed Antonelli a brief spell in clear air at the front from Russell and Lando Norris, with Mercedes not having any real strategic options to challenge for the win - not that Antonelli would have minded one bit while on title course.

Antonelli was the last from that offset trio to peel into the pits by lap 44, well over the halfway mark of the 71-lap race, demonstrating Red Bull had little to worry about regarding the durability of the soft tyre.

But just as Antonelli had pitted, giving up on the possibility of catching a lucky safety car, Valtteri Bottas's Cadillac hit the wall at Turn 1 with a left-front suspension failure, bringing out not just a safety car but a red flag. Bottas was taken to the medical centre for precautionary checks and was released without injuries.

Following a nearly 40-minute wait for barrier repairs, the race resumed with a standard restart with Verstappen leading from Leclerc, Hamilton, Antonelli, Norris, Russell and Piastri - all on a set of soft tyres. On the lap 47 restart, Verstappen was forced to defend against Hamilton, who enjoyed a huge launch off the line to motor past Leclerc into second.

As Leclerc locked up into Turn 1, Verstappen resisted Hamilton's advances through Mexico's first sector, the only real overtaking opportunity. But Hamilton didn't relent and continued applying pressure to the leading Red Bull.

Antonelli didn't want to celebrate his title success off the Foro Sol podium and lunged his way past Leclerc for third in Turn on lap 48. Suffering a lingering flat spot from his restart lock-up Leclerc's woes continued as he was then pressurised by Norris in the battle for fourth.
The race would receive another fresh twist when Arvid Lindblad crashed out of seventh after tangling with Piastri, bringing out another safety car.
That reset allowed Hamilton, who had been dropping out of Verstappen's slipstream, another chance to snatch the win away from his old rival when the racing resumed on lap 65.
But despite hounding Verstappen lap after lap, Hamilton ran out of options and had to settle for second as Verstappen took his third grand prix win of the season, and third in four races.
A tearful Antonelli cruised across the finish in third to soak in his drivers' world championship, beating Sebastian Vettel's age record by three full years aged 20.
Leclerc hung onto fourth ahead of Norris, Russell and Piastri. Franco Colapinto took eighth as best of the rest, with Liam Lawson and Pierre Gasly rounding out the top 10.
As well as retirements for Lindblad and Bortoleto, Oliver Bearman disappeared with suspension damage after being taken out by Nico Hulkenberg at Turn 4 on the restart.
The two Aston Martins suffered another character-building campaign as Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll were parked after just seven laps with new Honda power unit problems.

items.originalTitle: Five quick takeaways from historic Mexico GP
detailZh: 五个关于历史性的墨西哥大奖赛快速总结
基米·安东内利在墨西哥成为F1冠军，法拉利面临另一内部困境
安东内利以成熟的表现庆祝，在领奖台上大放异彩
享受加冕时刻却压力如此之小，真是奢侈。基米·安东内利承认这个周末他非常紧张，因为他的首次世界冠军即将到来，但他只需要保持岛屿上的状态，就可以轻松冲过终点线。
安东内利在墨西哥的排位赛中并没有发挥出最佳水平，但凭借着拉塞尔的慢起步，他从第五位发车开始受益，并开始跟随领跑者。
由于拉塞尔和汉密尔顿都没有赢得比赛，安东内利甚至不需要完成比赛。当他的主要车队对手们纷纷展开激烈竞争时，安东内利驾驶了一场成熟且低调的比赛——唯一的激动时刻出现在他利用红旗期间对查尔斯·勒克莱尔发起冲击，夺得第三名。这一举动确保了他将在墨西哥著名的福罗索尔体育场前庆祝他的首个冠军头衔。
在梅赛德斯没有占据上风的周末，这无疑是书写F1新篇章的值得骄傲的方式。
勒克莱尔与汉密尔顿的碰撞事件让法拉利失去了胜利。
法拉利在墨西哥站理想地处于赢得本赛季第三个胜利的位置。刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔在发车线上分别位列第一和第三，而前排发车的乔治·罗素在发车第二阶段像石头一样坠落。
在第一部分的弯道中，红色赛车车轮与车轮并行，汉密尔顿在3号弯道勉强保持领先，但当勒克莱尔在4号弯道外侧发起进攻时，两人都偏离了赛道，摩纳哥车手切过了弯角。
汉密尔顿失去了动力，被维斯塔潘超越；勒克莱尔被处以5秒罚时——由于减轻了处罚条件， stewards 解释说——但这不足以在维修区抵挡住维斯塔潘。
摩纳哥车手在第二次发车后又失去了两个位置——在瓦尔特里·博塔斯发生事故导致比赛红旗出动后——并且在过程中过度磨损了轮胎。
坦白说，这场比赛原本可能是法拉利的1-2，但最终在终点线前变成了2-4，因为它的车手们无法保持良好的行为。而且汉密尔顿坚持要求对他队友施加更严厉的处罚，这很可能也不是弗雷德·瓦瑟尔想看到的。
维斯塔潘的最新胜利证明红牛回来了
基米·安东内利是个幸运儿，因为红牛本赛季的起步并不顺利——而且维斯塔潘在早期就失去了太多积分，以至于在理论上还可能保持冠军争夺战。因为如果他保持在与对手竞争的距离内，今年意大利人将有更多的担忧。
相反，我们现在看到的情况并不是在锦标赛意义上的回归——但仍然展示了维斯塔潘能够成为一股怎样的力量。一旦红牛给他一辆足够好的车来在前面竞争，他就开始充分利用这一点。
他的墨西哥胜利是他最近四场比赛中的第三次胜利。自从他在赞德福特退役以来，他参加了每一场比赛并站上了领奖台——这就像任何其他暗示一样，表明你不能排除红牛及其荷兰飞人从明年冠军争夺战中的可能性。
里约·伊拉卡瓦完成了他所要求的一切
伊拉卡瓦前往墨西哥参加第一节练习，然后在安静的周末里从哈斯车队的维修区观看其他比赛。然而，周六早上，他被通知他还需要参加第三节练习、排位赛和比赛，因为车队在周五晚上与埃斯特班·奥康发生争执后决定放弃他。
32岁的日本车手在一级方程式赛车中首次亮相，没有人能对他提出更多的要求。是的，他在排位赛中落后队友近九十分之一秒，但他仍然在Q1中超越了三名对手，并在比赛中没有犯任何错误地完成了比赛，甚至不得不处理两次停车起步。
里约·平川，哈斯F1车队，劳拉·穆勒，哈斯F1车队
哈斯车队已经为其2027年的车手阵容做好了准备，有贝尔曼和卡马拉，但平川展示了如果奥康的情况仍然悬而未决，并且车队决定不立即提升卡马拉，而他在为F2冠军而战时，他可以证明自己的价值。然而，首先，平川下周还有另一个重要的任务：与队友一起在蒙扎的#8丰田车上确保WEC冠军。或者他应该去圣保罗参加F1比赛，因为即使他没有参加WEC，他也将被宣布为冠军？
博塔斯有理由对2027年感到“自信”吗？
瓦尔特里·博塔斯坚持认为他对在凯迪拉克车队2027年有一个座位“相当自信”，并表示“一切都需要在美国的大老板那里得到验证。”
然而，他在整个赛季的表现都不如队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯，这一点在本周末再次得到了体现。周六，他连续第四次未能获得杆位，落后了七十分之一。总比分是15-9，佩雷斯领先——值得一提的是，这位墨西哥人从未以特别出色的排位赛而闻名。
导致博塔斯撞上护栏的左前悬挂故障显然不是他的错，但在此之前他的周日表现一直很平淡。他在赛道后部挣扎，速度比佩雷斯慢得多，佩雷斯在比赛的开始阶段占据了第13位，并显示出凯迪拉克有更多的速度潜力。
博塔斯肯定对他与车队以及他座位的主要竞争对手科尔顿·赫塔的合同情况有更多的了解，而赫塔在F2或他的FP1比赛中也没有特别突出。不过，如果这位美国人最终获得明年超级驾照，将会很有趣看看会发生什么。
detailEn: Five quick takeaways from historic Mexico GP
Kimi Antonelli crowned F1 champion in Mexico as Ferrari faces another internal dilemma
Antonelli celebrates in style with mature podium drive

What a luxury to enjoy your coronation with so little pressure. Kimi Antonelli did admit to being extra tense this weekend as his maiden world championship loomed, but all he had to do was keep it on the island to cruise to the finish line.
Antonelli didn't have his finest qualifying session in Mexico, but from fifth on the grid he benefitted from Russell's slow start to get ahead and shadow the leaders.

With neither Russell nor Hamilton winning the race, Antonelli didn't even have to finish the race. And as virtually all of his top team rivals got their elbows out, Antonelli drove a mature and low-key race - the only bit of excitement coming when he made a lunge on Charles Leclerc to grab third after the red flag. That move ensured he would celebrate his maiden title on Mexico's famous podium fronting an electric Foro Sol stadium.
On a weekend Mercedes didn't have the upper hand, it was a worthy way to write a fresh chapter of F1 history.
Leclerc vs Hamilton incident costs Ferrari win

Ferrari was ideally positioned to claim its third victory of the season in Mexico. Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc were first and third on the grid, and front-row starter George Russell dropped like a stone in the second phase of the start.

The red cars went wheel to wheel in the first section of corners, with Hamilton narrowly retaining the lead out of Turn 3, but when Leclerc launched a move around the outside in Turn 4, both of them ended up going off track, with the Monegasque cutting the corner.

Hamilton lost momentum and was passed by Verstappen; Leclerc got a five-second penalty – more lenient than the regular 10 seconds due to mitigating circumstances, the stewards explained – but that wasn’t enough to hold Verstappen off in the pitlane.
The Monegasque went on to lose two more spots at the second start – after the race was red-flagged for Valtteri Bottas’ crash – and flat-spotted his tyres in the process.

Let’s put it plainly: this race could have been a Ferrari 1-2, and under the chequered flag it was a 2-4, because its drivers couldn’t behave. And Hamilton insistently calling for a harsher penalty for his team-mate likely wasn’t quite what Fred Vasseur wanted to see either.
Verstappen's latest win proves Red Bull is back

Kimi Antonelli is a lucky boy that Red Bull's start to the season wasn't great - and Max Verstappen lost too much ground early on to realistically remain in the championship fight. Because had he stayed within striking distance, there would be a lot more for the Italian to worry about this year.

Instead, what we're seeing now isn't a comeback in the championship sense - but it's still a demonstration of what a force Verstappen can be. As soon as Red Bull gave him a car good enough to fight at the front, he started making the most of it.

His Mexican victory is his third in the last four races. He's been on the podium in every single race since his retirement at Zandvoort - and that's as big a hint as any that you can't discount Red Bull and its Flying Dutchman from contention for next year's championship.
Ryo Hirakawa did exactly what was asked of him

Hirakawa travelled to Mexico to take part in FP1 before settling into a quiet weekend watching the rest of the action from the Haas garage. However, on Saturday morning, he was informed that he would also have to drive in FP3, qualifying and the race, following the team's decision to drop Esteban Ocon after a disagreement on Friday night.

At 32, the Japanese driver was making his debut in Formula 1, and there was little more anyone could have asked of him. Yes, he qualified almost nine tenths of a second behind his team-mate, but he still outqualified three rivals in Q1 and went on to complete the race without making a single mistake, even having to deal with two standing starts.
Ryo Hirakawa, Haas F1 Team, Laura Mueller, Haas F1 Team

Haas already has its 2027 driver line-up in place with Bearman and Camara, but Hirakawa showed that he could prove useful if the situation with Ocon remains unresolved and the team decides against promoting Camara just yet while he is fighting for the Formula 2 title. First, though, Hirakawa has another important assignment next weekend: securing the WEC title alongside his team-mates in the #8 Toyota at Monza. Or should he head to Sao Paulo with Formula 1 instead, given that he would be crowned champion anyway, even if he did not race in the WEC?
Is Bottas right to feel "confident" about 2027?
Valtteri Bottas insists he is "pretty confident" he has a seat secured at Cadillac for 2027 and says that "everything needs to be validated with the big bosses in the USA".

However, his performances throughout the season have fallen short of team-mate Sergio Perez's, and that was evident once again this weekend. On Saturday, he was outqualified for the fourth consecutive time, finishing seven tenths adrift. The overall score stands at 15-9 in Perez's favour — and it is worth remembering that the Mexican has never been renowned as a particularly strong qualifier.

The left-front suspension failure that sent Bottas into the barriers was certainly not his fault, but his Sunday had been anonymous until then. He struggled at the back of the field, with considerably less pace than Perez, who held 13th during the opening part of the race and showed that the Cadillac had the pace for more.

Bottas will surely know more about his contractual situation with the team, and his main rival for the seat, Colton Herta, has not particularly stood out in Formula 2 or during his FP1 outings either. Nevertheless, it will be interesting to see what happens if the American finally obtains his superlicence for next year.
keyPointsZh: 安东内利在墨西哥的排位赛中并非最佳，但最终从第五位发车
keyPointsEn: Antonelli's qualifying session was not his best in Mexico, but he started from fifth on the grid
